summary_1line: Genealogies and functions of various sacred fires are described, along with ritual corrections for Agnihotra and a myth of fire hiding and transforming into earthly substances.

image_candidates.scene_text: The fire-god, frightened of contamination, dives into the sea while fish reveal his hiding place to the searching gods.
After giving up his body, the fire spirit sinks into the earth and from his organs emerge metals, clouds, corals, and trees.
Bhrigu and Angiras perform severe penance until the hidden fire suddenly blazes forth with intense radiance.
